notes: Main disagreements: (1) doc 1 stance, delegates vs permit; resolved to permit because the page sets Carleton's own student rule and permits Gemini use. (2) policy_type for instructor-advice passages: P09 vs UNCOVERED for syllabus tone, P41 vs UNCOVERED for explain-the-rationale duties, P04 vs P02/P09 for per-assignment rules; resolved by comparing to type definitions, leaving 7 UNCOVERED units under one proposed new type (instructors explain/discuss AI rules with students). (3) phase before-course vs course-start for syllabus-statement advice; resolved to course-start when the passage is about what students are told. (4) modality should vs informs vs must for advice passages, resolved by the verb in the source (need to = should, 'you'll also need to' = must, 'under no circumstances' = must-not). (5) P29 vs P32 for the core-intellectual-substance rule, resolved to P32. Only-one-coder units were all real statements and kept, except one repeat Key Ideas bullet (reiterate on prompts) dropped.
